english.description: Every vat at full depth, matched to a full hand.
english.name: BOARD_VAT_DEEP

english.description: Learn Ringed Labels. A ring marks a cabinet's missing potions through the walls.
english.name: BOARD_SIGHT_MAX

english.description: Learn Set Sight. The room finally shows you how it goes back together.
english.name: BOARD_CAPSTONE

english.description: Every node on the board bought. The rest is yours to pour.
english.name: BOARD_ALL

english.description: Pour from one vessel into another.
english.name: VERB_POUR

english.description: Fill a potion with four units of its own colour. It seals itself, for good.
english.name: VERB_FINISH

english.description: Finish and shelve every potion in the little heap by the door.
english.name: VERB_DOORWAY

english.description: Undo a move. Nothing here is ever lost for long.
english.name: VERB_UNDO

english.description: Pour a colour into a vat and leave it there.
english.name: VERB_VAT_IN

english.description: Draw a colour back out of a vat and into a waiting potion.
english.name: VERB_VAT_OUT

english.description: Let a finished potion stow itself in the apron.
english.name: VERB_APRON

english.description: Hold seven vessels at one time.
english.name: VERB_HAND_SEVEN

english.description: Every beaker in the lab standing in a bench socket. Nobody asked you to.
english.displayName: Not a Beaker Out of Place
english.name: FLAV_BEAKERS

english.description: An hour in the lab without stepping away.
english.displayName: A Long Night at the Bench
english.name: FLAV_LONG_SESSION

english.description: Pet the lab cat fifteen times. The apothecary was the cat's before it was yours.
english.name: FLAV_CAT

schinese.description: 把第一瓶完成的魔药放到属于它的架子上。
schinese.name: HOME_0001

schinese.description: 五十瓶魔药完成，各归其位。
schinese.name: HOME_0050

schinese.description: 两百五十瓶魔药各就各位，地板开始露出来了。
schinese.name: HOME_0250

schinese.description: 五百瓶魔药归位，工坊的一角总算整齐了。
schinese.name: HOME_0500

schinese.description: 一千瓶魔药完成并上架。药堆比原先小了。
schinese.name: HOME_1000

schinese.description: 一千五百瓶归位，好走的那一段早已过去。
schinese.name: HOME_1500

schinese.description: 两千零八十道封印亮起 - 正好是楼里所有搁板的一半。
schinese.name: HOME_2080

schinese.description: 4160 瓶魔药全部完成，各自立于自己的徽记之上。工坊完整如初，爷爷也快回来了。
schinese.name: HOME_4160

schinese.description: 五百瓶魔药已经完成。至于是否都归了位，那是另一回事。
schinese.name: FIN_0500

schinese.description: 两千零八十瓶魔药完成 - 咒语打乱的一切，已经理清了一半。
schinese.name: FIN_2080

schinese.description: 4160 瓶魔药全部完成。药堆消失了，最后几瓶还等着被送回架上。
schinese.name: FIN_4160

schinese.description: 把一层搁板从头到尾填满，每一道封印都亮起。
schinese.name: ROOM_SHELF_FIRST

schinese.description: 一座药柜的八十个格位全部填满，铭牌随之亮起。
schinese.name: ROOM_SECTION_FIRST

schinese.description: 一族的四座药柜全部完成，同悬一面旗下。
schinese.name: ROOM_FAMILY_FIRST

schinese.description: 学会「回退」。此后任何一步都能随时撤回。
schinese.name: BOARD_FIRST_POINT

schinese.description: 一次携带七个容器。满手，但没人替你倒。
schinese.name: BOARD_HAND_MAX

schinese.description: 围裙四个口袋。只放封好的瓶子，里面的东西一滴也倒不出来。
schinese.name: BOARD_APRON_MAX

schinese.description: 每一口药缸都达到最大容量，正好配得上满手。
schinese.name: BOARD_VAT_DEEP

schinese.description: 学会「标签光环」。光环透过墙壁标出药柜缺少的魔药。
schinese.name: BOARD_SIGHT_MAX

schinese.description: 学会「成组之视」。这间屋子终于让你看见，它是怎样重新拼合的。
schinese.name: BOARD_CAPSTONE

schinese.description: 技能板上的每个节点都已买下。剩下的，就交给你去倒了。
schinese.name: BOARD_ALL

schinese.description: 把一个容器里的液体倒进另一个。
schinese.name: VERB_POUR

schinese.description: 用四份属于它自己的颜色把一瓶魔药灌满。它会自行封口，从此不再打开。
schinese.name: VERB_FINISH

schinese.description: 把门边那一小堆魔药全部完成并归位。
schinese.name: VERB_DOORWAY

schinese.description: 撤回一步。在这里，没有什么会丢失太久。
schinese.name: VERB_UNDO

schinese.description: 把一种颜色倒进药缸，就放在那儿。
schinese.name: VERB_VAT_IN

schinese.description: 从药缸里把一种颜色取回，倒进等着它的魔药。
schinese.name: VERB_VAT_OUT

schinese.description: 让一瓶完成的魔药自己收进围裙里。
schinese.name: VERB_APRON

schinese.description: 同时握住七个容器。
schinese.name: VERB_HAND_SEVEN

schinese.description: 工坊里的每一只烧杯都插回了工作台的凹槽。没人要求你这么做。
schinese.name: FLAV_BEAKERS

schinese.description: 在工坊里连续待上一个小时，一步也没离开。
schinese.name: FLAV_LONG_SESSION

schinese.description: 抚摸魔药铺的猫十五次。这间铺子先是它的，才是你的。
schinese.name: FLAV_CAT
